description: Named by Central's trust tier label (Growth). What a team on it may do: live keys, monthly spend across its keys' caps, and the rate limits its keys run under when they carry none of their own. Central names a team's tier and renames it when the label changes; the values here are Grove's to edit.

fields.description: What a team's live keys may spend in a month together: Σ the keys' caps stays within it. 0 lets no cap be set. Lowering it stops no key; it only refuses a raise or a new cap until the caps fit again.
fields.label: Spend Limit (USD / month)

fields.description: Counted on the gateway per team and model, per Gateway Store, however many keys the team holds; a window resets on the UTC clock. One row per model, metric and window: a blank model is every model, a named one stands in for it there. No rows: the tier's teams are uncapped. The rows are the catalog's while this is the table in force — catalog.json rewrites them on every migrate — and reach every key of every team on the tier at the next sync. A value of 0 is no limit on that row's model, metric and window. A team's own rows are laid over these.
fields.label: Limits

fields.description: Who the rate limits are counted for, one or the other: Team, the team as a whole on each model however many keys it holds, or Key, each of its keys on its own (a trial tier, where every key is another customer). Each has its own table of rows; only the one picked is shown and in force.
fields.label: Limits Count Per

fields.description: Counted on the gateway under each key of the tier's teams on its own, per model and Gateway Store. Rows as in Limits: a blank model is every model, a named one stands in for it there, a value of 0 is no limit. No rows: uncapped. The rows are the catalog's while this is the table in force. A team's own rows are laid over these.
fields.label: Limits Per Key

name: Tier
